exposure: Conception mode (spontaneous vs. assisted reproductive technology (ART))
cohort: 532 women aged 42 years or older who gave birth
finding: While maternal and fetal risks increase in late pregnancies (42 years or older), pregnancies conceived through ART are associated with more pregnancy-related complications compared to spontaneous conceptions.
mod_finding: Pregnancies resulting from assisted reproductive technology (ART) had higher rates of cesarean section compared to spontaneous pregnancies.
